title: Step 3 - Implementing KNN Classification in R: Adapting the Classifier Template

cues.en: -: So, I know it's supposed to be a template that worked for every classifier, but the KNN classifier will be the only classifier we will need to change something in the template
cues.zh: 我知道這應該是適用於每個分類器的範本，但 KNN 會是唯一需要修改範本的分類器。

cues.en: and that's because of this structure we changed here.
cues.zh: 原因就是這裡改過的結構。

cues.en: For all the classifiers, we had this first section, where we create our classifier with the classifier equals and then we create our classifier with the function.
cues.zh: 對其他分類器而言，第一部分會先寫 classifier 等於某個函式，來建立分類器。

cues.en: And then in another section, we create a y_pred, using the classifier we built in this section above.
cues.zh: 接著在另一部分，使用上方建立的分類器來產生 y_pred。

cues.en: But here, since we did both at the same time, we just need to change a little thing here in the template.
cues.zh: 但這裡兩件事同時完成，所以只要稍微修改範本。

cues.en: Can you guess what it is?
cues.zh: 猜得到要改什麼嗎？

cues.en: Okay. So, it's actually in this line because, as you can see here, we are using the predict function on our classifier. But here, since we didn't create a classifier separately
cues.zh: 好，其實就是這一行。你可以看到這裡對分類器使用 predict 函式，但我們沒有把分類器與

cues.en: from the vector of prediction y_pred, well, that means that this predict classifier doesn't mean anything here.
cues.zh: 預測向量 y_pred 分開建立，所以這裡的 predict(classifier) 就沒有意義。

cues.en: So, actually, it's really simple.
cues.zh: 其實非常簡單。

cues.en: What we only need to do is to replace this predict classifier, newdata = grid_set by this code here.
cues.zh: 只要把 predict(classifier, newdata = grid_set) 換成這段程式碼。

cues.en: Because this is actually like the predict function, only it's creating the classifier and making the predictions at the same time.
cues.zh: 因為它的作用就像 predict 函式，只是同時建立分類器並進行預測。

cues.en: So, there is not a predict function here.
cues.zh: 因此這裡不會用 predict 函式。

cues.en: So, it's very simple.
cues.zh: 非常簡單。

cues.en: What we only need to do is to take this, Command + C and here, since it's all the predictions of the pixel points in the grid,
cues.zh: 只要取這段，按 Command + C。這裡要預測的是網格中所有像素點，

cues.en: we will need to change this newdata = test_set.
cues.zh: 所以需要修改這個 newdata = test_set。

cues.en: So, this test = test_set by grid_set.
cues.zh: 也就是把 test = test_set 換成 grid_set。

cues.en: So, basically, it will be very simple.
cues.zh: 基本上很簡單。

cues.en: We will remove this predict function here and paste that.
cues.zh: 移除這裡的 predict 函式，再貼上這段。

cues.en: And here we're just going to replace test_set by grid_set.
cues.zh: 這裡只要把 test_set 換成 grid_set。

cues.en: Because we want to predict if those imaginary pixel point, that we picture as imaginary users of the social network, will buy yes or no, the SUV,
cues.zh: 因為我們把那些假想像素點想成社群網路的假想使用者，要預測他們是否會購買 SUV，

cues.en: according to their coordinates in the graph, that is their age and their estimated salary.
cues.zh: 依據的是圖中的座標，也就是年齡與預估薪資。

cues.en: And then once the prediction is done, it will be colorized in the proper color.
cues.zh: 預測完成後，就塗上適當顏色。

cues.en: Green if this imaginary user pixel point is predicted to buy the SUV.
cues.zh: 若預測這個假想使用者像素點會購買 SUV，就用綠色。

cues.en: And red if it's predicted not to buy the SUV.
cues.zh: 若預測不會購買 SUV，就用紅色。

cues.en: And that's it. That's all we need.
cues.zh: 就這樣，所需的修改只有這些。

cues.en: So, we are going to select this as well and paste it here, to do the same for the test.
cues.zh: 我們也選取這段，貼到這裡，對測試集做一樣的修改。

cues.en: Of course, it's the same. And here we go.
cues.zh: 當然是一樣的，好了。

cues.en: And then we're all good to plot the results.
cues.zh: 現在就可以繪製結果。

cues.en: So, let's do this. We're gonna select this and let's see what we obtain.
cues.zh: 來做吧，選取這段，看看會得到什麼。

cues.en: Command + Control + Enter to execute the graph.
cues.zh: 按 Command + Control + Enter 執行繪圖。

cues.en: The plot is coming. You're gonna see how the KNN manages to classify the two classes of users, those who didn't buy the SUV and those who bought the SUV.
cues.zh: 圖正在產生，你會看到 KNN 如何分類兩群使用者，也就是沒有購買 SUV 與有購買 SUV 的人。

cues.en: And here we go. That's the graph.
cues.zh: 好，這就是圖。

cues.en: That's the prediction boundary here.
cues.zh: 這裡就是預測邊界。

cues.en: So, you can see there are a lot of irregularities, but that's because of the way the KNN model works because it's taking each time the five nearest neighbors,
cues.zh: 可以看到很多不規則處，這是 KNN 模型運作方式造成的，因為每次都取最近的五個鄰居。

cues.en: that's all the prediction boundary.
cues.zh: 這整條都是預測邊界。

cues.en: These are our two prediction regions, the red one and the green one.
cues.zh: 這是兩個預測區域，紅色與綠色。

cues.en: All these points, or are the real observation points, are real users of the data set and they're real results whether they bought, "Yes, the SUV" if it's green, and "No, they didn't buy the SUV" so it's red.
cues.zh: 這些點全都是真實觀測值，是資料集中的真實使用者及其真實結果。綠色表示購買了 SUV，紅色表示沒有購買。

cues.en: So, we can see that most of our predictions are correct because all the red points are in the red region and most of the green points are in the green region.
cues.zh: 可以看到大部分預測正確，因為所有紅點都在紅色區域，大多數綠點也在綠色區域。

cues.en: We also see that the KNN classifier makes a much better job at classifying those users here, that their logistic regression couldn't classify correctly
cues.zh: 也能看到 KNN 更擅長分類這些使用者，邏輯斯迴歸原先無法正確分類他們，

cues.en: because it was a straight line and some green points were falling on the red region.
cues.zh: 因為它的邊界是直線，部分綠點會落在紅色區域。

cues.en: So, here it's doing a much better job and all those users with an age above the average and an estimated salary below the average, are now well classified in the green region.
cues.zh: 這裡表現好多了，年齡高於平均、預估薪資低於平均的這些使用者，現在都正確分類到綠色區域。

cues.en: So, very good. Very good.
cues.zh: 非常好。

cues.en: But let's not scream victory until we find out about the results on the test set because since this is the training set and the KNN classifier was built on a training set,
cues.zh: 不過，在看到測試集結果前先別急著慶祝，因為這是訓練集，KNN 分類器也是用訓練集建立的，

cues.en: we might get different results on the test set.
cues.zh: 在測試集上可能得到不同結果。

cues.en: So, let's see. We're gonna select this.
cues.zh: 來看看，選取這段。

cues.en: The test set results are ready. Execute.
cues.zh: 測試集結果準備好了，執行。

cues.en: And these are great results.
cues.zh: 這些結果很棒。

cues.en: Most of the red points are in the red region, most of the green points are in the green region.
cues.zh: 大多數紅點都在紅色區域，大多數綠點都在綠色區域。

cues.en: And of course, we had a few incorrect predictions, like these two guys here or these two guys here.
cues.zh: 當然，仍有幾筆錯誤預測，像這裡這兩個點，或這裡這兩個點。

cues.en: But here, it looks very good.
cues.zh: 不過這裡看起來很好。

cues.en: And we have made nice prediction regions.
cues.zh: 我們得到很不錯的預測區域。

cues.en: Okay, so that's it for this tutorial.
cues.zh: 好，這堂教學就到這裡。

cues.en: I hope you enjoy discovering this new type of classifier.
cues.zh: 希望你喜歡認識這種新的分類器。

cues.en: We are going to discover new kinds of classifiers in the next sections. I can't wait to show you this and until then, enjoy Machine Learning.
cues.zh: 接下來幾節會探索其他分類器，我迫不及待要介紹給你。在此之前，享受機器學習吧。
